text:
maria: Hey — noticed p50 on the main latency dashboard is ~20ms lower than the endpoint breakdown for /v2/generate. p95/p99 line up though. Anyone else seeing a mismatch? Screenshot: https://redwood.local/snap/abc123

alex: Which dashboard view? route-level rollup vs endpoint breakdown? Time window?

maria: Route-level (the default 'service' view) for last 1h. Main p50 shows ~40ms, endpoint-level shows ~60ms. p99 both ~300ms.

jamal: Could be sampling origin or merge behavior. We flipped rollup mode to tdigest-merge last week. That can shift medians if sample weights differ. @sophia fyi.

sophia: We have merge_by_route enabled for that service. Tdigest shouldn't normally change medians that much unless the underlying sample sets are different. Do you have sample counts? Any client filters?

maria: Raw counts: route-level sample_count=1200, endpoint-level sum(samples)=800. Route-level has more samples which looks wrong.

alex: Aha — route-level rollup includes internal fallback traffic and synthetic warmups (we tag those with route but not endpoint). Endpoint breakdown filters on `client_type=external` so counts differ.

jamal: I can reproduce. When tdigest merges sketches with different sample origins and weights, p50 drifts. Two fixes: align filters so both queries use `client_type=external`, or compute percentiles from sketches that only include external samples before merge.

sophia: UX suggestion: show a "sample origin" badge on the latency widget and surface sample_count in the tooltip. Also label aggregation mode (e.g., "aggregation: tdigest-merge") so it's obvious.

maria: Quick config idea: set `rollup.sample_origin=client_type` by default for user-facing dashboards (so rollups only merge same-origin samples). Is that safe?

alex: Low-risk but will affect a lot of dashboards. Recommend adding a UI hint and a migration toggle rather than forcing immediately.

opsbot: deploy: staging/dashboard-rollup-badge deployed by @liam — 2026-03-20T14:02:00Z

liam: Deployed the sample-origin badge to staging. Can folks validate @maria @jamal?

maria: Checked staging — counts line up when toggle is set. p50 now matches endpoint breakdown if you enable the external-only filter. I'll open a PR to add the tooltip and docs.

jamal: Filed ENG-7890 with repro steps and added the sample SQL: 
```
SELECT
  endpoint,
  tdigest_percentile(tdigest_sketch, 0.5) AS p50,
  sum(samples) AS samples
FROM telemetry_rollups
WHERE route = '/v2/generate' AND client_type = 'external'
GROUP BY endpoint;
```

sophia: Nice. Also propose an alert when rollup sample_count differs >20% from endpoint sums for the same window. That would catch these silently drifting dashboards.

maria: Agreed. Thanks all :thumbsup:
